Explore Literature.guide: Help → User guides → What is Explore Literature?
Explore Literature.prompt: Find and rank papers on [topic]. Period: [only if required]. Separate journal articles, reviews, preprints and theses. State query, sources and whether the digest reads abstracts only.

Deep Research.guide: Help → User guides → What is Deep Research?
Deep Research.prompt: Research [question] for [business/academic/general purpose]. System/context: [details]; constraints: [details]; period: [if required]. Compare mechanisms, methods and conflicting evidence. Give citations and identify which full texts or fragments were actually read.

Validate a Claim.prompt: Evaluate evidence for this single claim: [claim]. Separate supporting, contradicting and indirect sources; report design, context and limitations. A bibliography match alone does not verify the claim.

Analyze Research Landscape.prompt: Map [short topic]: clusters, trends, gaps and acknowledged funding. State corpus and matching rules; distinguish substantive gaps from missing index coverage. Start with Balanced breadth.

Chat with Papers.price_as_listed: PDF upload: 1 per run; other costs depend on current product
Chat with Papers.prompt: From the lawfully provided PDFs, answer [questions], citing pages and versions. Compare findings in a table and state exact reading scope. Do not infer whole-paper reading from selected passages.

Create Literature Review.price_as_listed: 7 up to 15 papers; +1 per five extra papers
formats: Literature review for an NSF/NIH proposal
Create Literature Review.prompt: Synthesize the processed PDFs for [purpose and format]. Separate findings, limitations, conflicting evidence and gaps. Verify bibliography. State disclosure of AI assistance as applicable.

Schedule Briefing.price_as_listed: Up to 3 briefings free for 6 months; 6 briefings advertised at $4/month
Schedule Briefing.instructions: Only after an explicit scheduling/subscription request: review title, field, include/exclude terms and day of month, then confirm the actual current terms before activating.
